content: अभि {%ind.%} .²1 (As a prefix to verbs and nouns) It means .³({%a%}) ‘to’, ‘towards’, ‘in the direction of’; अभिगम् to go towards; अभिया, ˚गमनम्, ˚यानम् <ab>&c.</ab>; .³({%b%}) ‘for’ ‘against’; ˚लष्, ˚पत् <ab>&c.</ab>; .³({%c%}) ‘on’, ‘upon’; ˚सिञ्च् to sprinkle on <ab>&c.</ab>; .³({%d%}) ‘over’, ‘above’, ‘across’; ˚भू to overpower, ˚तन्; .³({%e%}) ‘greatly’; ‘excessively’; ˚कम्प्. .²2 (As a prefix to nouns not derived from verbs, and to adjectives) It expresses .³({%a%}) intensity or superiority; ˚धर्मः ‘supreme duty’; ˚ताम्र ‘very red’; <ls>R. 15. 49</ls>; ˚नव ‘very new’; .³({%b%}) ‘towards’, ‘in the direction of’, forming <ab>adv.</ab> compounds; ˚चैद्यम्, ˚मुखम्, ˚दूति <ab>&c.</ab> .²3 (As a separable adverb) It means towards, in the direction or vicinity of (<ab>opp.</ab> अप); in, above, aloft, on the top, (mostly <ab>Ved.</ab>) .²4 (As a preposition with <ab>acc.</ab>) .³({%a%}) To, towards, in the direction of, against; (with <ab>acc.</ab> or in <ab>comp.</ab> in this sense); अभ्यग्नि or अग्निमभि शलभाः पतन्ति; वृक्षमभि द्योतते विद्युत् <ls>Sk.</ls>; <ls>Śi. 9. 56</ls>, <ls n="Śi. 9.">40</ls>; अभ्यर्कबिम्बं स्थितः <ls>Ś. 7. 11</ls>. .³({%b%}) Near, before, in front or presence of; प्रियमभि कुसुमोद्यतस्य बाहोः <ls>Śi. 7. 32</ls>, <ls n="Śi.">15. 58</ls>. .³({%c%}) On, upon, with regard or reference to; सायमण्डलमभि त्वरयन्त्यः <ls>Ki. 9. 6</ls>; साधुर्देवदत्तो मातरमभि <ls>Sk.</ls> .³({%d%}) Severally, one after another (in a distributive sense); वृक्षं वृक्षमभि सिञ्चति <ls>Sk.</ls>; भूतभूतमभि प्रभुः <ls>Bop.</ls> By अभिरभाग <ls>P. I. 4. 91</ls>. अभि has all the senses of अनु given in <ls>P. I. 4. 90</ls> except that of भाग; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} (लक्षणे) हरिमभि वर्तते; (इत्थंभूताख्याने) भक्तो हरिमभि; (वीप्सायाम्), देवं देवमाभि सिञ्चति; but यदत्र ममाभिष्यात् तद्दीयताम्; प्राज्ञो गोविन्दमभितिष्ठति <ls>Bop.</ls> .³({%e%}) In, into, to; <ls>Śi. 8. 60</ls>. .³({%f%}) For, for the sake of, on account of (<ab>Ved.</ab>). According to <ls>G. M.</ls> अभि has these senses:-- अभि पूजाभृशार्थेच्छासौम्याभिमुख्यसौरूप्यवचनाहारस्वाध्यायेषु; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} पूजायाम्, अभिवन्दते; भृशे, अभिनिवेशः; इच्छायाम्, अभिलाषः, अभिकः; सौम्ये or माधुर्ये, अभिजातः; आभिमुख्ये, अभिमुखम्, अभ्यग्नि; सौरूप्ये, अभिरूपम्; वचने, अभिधत्ते; आहारे, अभ्यवहरति; स्वाध्याये, अभ्यस्यति. [<ab>cf.</ab> <lang>L.</lang> {%ob%}; <lang>Gr.</lang> {%amphi%}; <lang>Zend.</lang> {%aibi%} or {%aiwi%}, <lang>Goth.</lang> {%bi%}; also {%umbi um%}].
